successModal.message: Thank you for your reseller application. Our sales team will review your request and contact you with the next steps.

hero.text: Bring naturally inspired, expert-led pet care to your customers. Complete the reseller application form and our sales team will review your request before contacting you with the next steps.

notes.title: Expert formulas
notes.desc: Care routines developed with a professional approach to hygiene and well-being.

notes.title: French laboratory
notes.desc: A brand born in Angers, crafted with precision and long-term trust.

notes.title: Sales support
notes.desc: Commercial follow-up to help qualified partners build the right assortment.

glassCard.title: Natural care, curated for professionals.
glassCard.text: From pet shops and grooming salons to veterinary-led retail environments, Biogance supports partners who share the same ambition: cleaner routines, visible results and trusted care for every companion.

experience.copy: The reseller journey has been designed to be clear, selective and efficient. Once your information has been submitted, the Biogance sales team can qualify your business profile, understand your distribution needs and guide you toward the most relevant professional offer.

cards.title: Share your company details
cards.desc: Complete your company, contact and VAT details so our team can identify your professional profile quickly.

cards.title: Define your product interests
cards.desc: Select the Biogance categories you would like to distribute, from grooming essentials to certified natural care routines.

cards.title: Get contacted by sales
cards.desc: After review, a Biogance sales representative will contact you to discuss reseller conditions, catalogue access and next steps.

aside.title: Apply for professional access.
aside.intro: Share a few essential details so our commercial team can qualify your request and contact you with the right B2B conditions.

process.title: Submit your request

process.title: Commercial review
process.desc: We check your activity, market and product needs.

process.title: Personal follow-up
